hypothesis: PD-1 blockade efficacy will be inversely proportional to the degree of tumor microenvironment-mediated T-cell suppression
prediction: Tumors with higher T-cell suppression markers will show lower response rates to PD-1 blockade
measurement_method: Quantify T-cell suppression markers (e.g., T-regulatory cell count, inhibitory cytokine levels) in tumor biopsies and correlate with objective response rate to PD-1 blockade treatment
falsification_condition: A positive correlation (r > 0.5) between T-cell suppression markers and PD-1 blockade response rate
